evidence: The wafer used in this work is a modulation-doped semiconductor heterostructure grown by metal-organic vapor phase epitaxy. On a semi-insulating InP:Fe substrate, a 50 nm thick undoped buffer layer ,a9n m thick In0.75Ga0.25As quantum well, a 20 nm thick undoped InP layer ,a1n m thick Si-doped InP layer, and finally a 20 nm thick InP cap layer are grown epitaxially. ... To obtain a clean and insulating heterostructure surface prior to growth of HfO2, the sample is etched in diluted HF acid (HF: H2O = 1:4) for 20 min followed by sulfur passivation in solution of (NH4)2Sx : H2O = 1:9 at 60 ° C for 20 min.
